description:
Hushfeed v0.68.0 has 106 patches for global TikTok 47.0.3, 47.1.3 and 47.1.4 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Original photos save as full-size JPEGs now, so they open in any gallery. Hiding the status bar takes TikTok's black strip with it, and Feed screen > Hide the Clear display controls clears what's left on Clear display. Automatic Clear Display catches the first video too.

Back up, Restore, Import watch history and the Feature Gate Lab's file actions offer to stop waiting when a file app hangs, and settings search puts whole-word matches first. See the changelog for the full list.

Validation: 2877 runtime tests passed and 546 patch tests passed locally. Both Android lint checks passed. All 106 patches applied to all three supported APKs with resource and manifest checks. The attached release receipt identifies the exact source and bundle. JPEG photo saves and stopping a stuck file app were checked on a Samsung phone running TikTok 47.0.3.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
